name: Freedom 4 Person Infrared Sauna
description:
OUR FREEDOM INFRARED SAUNA COLLECTION
The Canadian Western Red Cedar wood's character, texture, and rich scent set our Freedom Collection apart. This carefully handcrafted and beautiful wood fixture is well appointed with our iconic carbon fiber technology for heat. The thoughtful configuration helps maximize the heating area and the benefits of your sauna. We use six far-infrared carbon fiber heating panels in our one-person units and up to nine such panels in our multi-person units providing excellent coverage. These gorgeous units are the epitome of personal luxury and come well-appointed with all of our state-of-the-art features, such as a premium sound system, LED lighting, and a digital control panel.
This unit is designed for maximum space and comfort, an excellent choice for a big family. The 4 Person Infrared Sauna is specifically designed for relaxation and casual enjoyment.
